factor: At least one complete native H1 candle inside the original confirmed 12H key displays the V1.7 default same-direction check/cross. Stoch(5,3,3) both lines below 20 on a bullish crossover or both above 80 on a bearish crossunder. The same H1 wick must strictly cross the parent's touched NY Monday 1.618 and be dated Tuesday through Friday locally. Fix H1 once, no extra lookback or oscillator search. Distinct from Stoch computed on the 12H key itself.
clock: Use all twelve finished H1 candles from key open to confirmation only, with ten consecutive H1 observations through the first hour. The executed entry remains the original first V1.7 12H confirmation. Look at paired later clocks on their own H1 prices using their original same-week parent's level. Missing or discontinuous windows are explicitly excluded. Values numerically equal to 1.618 at relative precision 1e-12 are treated as touching, consistent with strict cross semantics.
